evidence_quotes.agenda: No quid pro quo framing or agenda question — went straight into confirming move details after the greeting.

coaching_note: The customer's heat-exhaustion worry about the crew got a reassurance but no real second layer (no mention of breaks, pacing, or hydration) — a missed chance to build trust on a concern that was clearly on the customer's mind.
